507602.caption: What a pity, Commander. This frame has no synthetic skin whatsoever apart from the face. Even someone like you would think that this looks really ugly, wouldn't you? ...It's not bad? Are your eyes going bad?

507603.caption: Should I even count this outcome as a light in the darkness even though this was made with Nyto technology? At least this body is of a purely mechanical construction... Perhaps this is because "that woman" knew where my bottom line was... How frustrating.

507604.caption: DEFY huh... The team still exists, of course. It's just that things have changed too much... Well, nothing will always remain the same.

507605.caption: ...Revenge was indeed the first thing that came to mind when I was reborn, but I will not repeat the mistakes of others. To me, the most important thing is to inherit Ange's will and legacy. Are you willing to go to hell with me, Commander?
